title: Believe the hype for Wardogs, possibly the next great multiplayer FPS | PC Gamer
quote: Peeling back another layer reveals a logistical metagame familiar to milsims: building FOBs (forward operating bases), constructing defenses, transporting supplies, and controlling strategic locations.

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 review | PC Gamer
quote: By gluing our boots more firmly to the ground, Call of Duty has finally created the space to be a tactical FPS.

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Single-Player Review - IGN
quote: Thanks to a lackluster story, fumbled mechanical innovations, and largely underwhelming mission design, this year’s Call of Duty campaign is an unfortunate misfire that fails to live up to standards set by not only its unforgettable 2009 namesake, but also its 2019 predecessor.

title: Xenoblade Chronicles 3 Review - IGN
quote: With Xenoblade Chronicles 3, massive improvements have been made to combat, quest design, and the RPG sandbox, while retaining the absurd and awesome environments, and a laser-focus on great characters and an impressive (if convoluted) story.

title: Pokémon Scarlet and Violet Review - IGN
quote: But from the moment I left the hallowed halls of Uva Academy, that promise has been wonderfully fulfilled, with open-world, open-ended gameplay serving as a shining beacon for the future of this beloved franchise.

title: A Plague Tale: Requiem Review - IGN
quote: This follow-up to one of my favorite action-adventure games of the previous console generation turns the dials up to 11 in practically every way, and overwhelmingly benefits from those escalations despite sometimes being a bit heavy on the nihilism.

title: A Plague Tale: Requiem review | PC Gamer
quote: It's hard to begrudge Requiem this unevenness when so much of what it does lands exactly as intended

title: Sifu Review - IGN
quote: Absolver developer Sloclap’s latest martial arts beat-em-up is bold, its combat exquisite, its animation top-notch, its music outstanding, and its story – while very simple – is poignant and elegantly told.
